Repairs & Leak Detection

Roof Restoration

Common questions

Before you book

It depends on size, material, pitch and access — no two roofs are the same, so we don't publish fixed prices. After a free on-roof inspection we'll give you one fixed, itemised written quote, with no obligation to go ahead.
Timing depends on the size and complexity of the job and the weather. Your home stays watertight every night during the work, and we'll confirm a schedule with you before we start.
Like-for-like roof replacement is generally exempt development in NSW, but heritage-listed homes and some changes of material or colour can need approval. We'll flag this during your inspection and help with the paperwork if it's required.
If it's safe, place a bucket under the drip and move valuables away from the area — never climb on a wet roof yourself. Call us on (02) 4081 4646 and we'll arrange a make-safe visit: temporary sealing or tarping to stop further damage, photos for insurance, then a written quote for the permanent repair.
If your tiles and structure are sound but the surface, bedding and pointing have failed, a restoration can extend the life of your roof for less than the cost of a full replacement. If there's widespread rust, sagging, or timber damage, replacement is usually the smarter long-term spend. Our inspection report shows you the evidence so you can decide with confidence.
